integrity: Exact polynomial proof and explicit uniform discrete-limit argument, corroborated by stand-alone SymPy and rational arithmetic. No independent scientific audit or independently established publication priority.
scientific_limitations: The theorem applies only to the given planar cubic amplitude-frequency family and the exact RK325 tableau; the Riccati law is limited to scaled times strictly below 128. No actual discrete divergence at the formal limiting pole is claimed. The 2024 first version of the source manuscript contains linear analysis; its RK325 nonlinear construction first appears in the 2026 revision.
title: Resonant ninth-order energy drift and a Riccati slow-time law for nonlinear RK325
